findings.evidence: The BeforeValidator widening changes accepted input and published descriptions for every user of TagList, ShortTextList and StepList, but the schema contract snapshots only the 30 knowledge tools; any tool outside that set that uses these types silently gains string acceptance and unguarded schema d
findings.title: Coverage of every user of the shared list types is not evidenced

findings.evidence: The new text says objects retain `{order?, title, command?, description?}`, while the unchanged published schema description for brain_create_runbook.steps in tests/fixtures/mcp_knowledge_tool_input_schemas_base.json says `{order?, title, command?, verification?}` — `description?` vs `verification?`

findings.evidence: Any single string whose stripped form starts with '[' but is not valid JSON is refused with 'looks like a JSON list but is not valid JSON', so legitimate free-text values such as a step title '[1] Build image' or a tag '[urgent]' are rejected even though accepting model-sent strings is the purpose o
findings.title: Bracket-leading free text is refused

findings.evidence: The validator catches only json.JSONDecodeError; json.loads on deeply nested brackets (e.g. '[' * 20000 + ']' * 20000) raises RecursionError, which surfaces as an unhandled server error instead of a clean validation refusal. Whether transport-level message-size limits already bound this is a questio
findings.title: RecursionError from deeply nested JSON escapes the validator

findings.evidence: test_text_list_item_bound_applies_after_string_coercion actually asserts the per-item max_length (a 101-character single string coerced to one item), not the list maxItems bound; no test feeds a valid JSON list with more than LIST_MAX_ITEMS items to confirm maxItems still applies after BeforeValidat
findings.title: List-bound-after-coercion untested; test name overstates

findings.evidence: published_input_schemas() relies on `await server._list_tools()`, a private fastmcp method; a fastmcp upgrade can silently break the contract-test tooling.
findings.title: Private fastmcp API in snapshot tooling
